question: In December 2021, to improve leadership skills of grassroot women political leaders, the National Commission for Women (NCW) launched a pan-India capacity building programme. What is the name of this programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**'She is a Changemaker'**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **December 2021, the National Commission for Women (NCW**) launched the pan-India capacity-building programme called **"She is a Changemaker"** to enhance the leadership skills of grassroots women political leaders.
 
• This initiative **aimed to empower women in politics and governance by providing them with the necessary tools and training to strengthen their roles in decision-making.**
 
• **It is ** to e**nhance the leadership abilities of women serving in Panchayati Raj Institutions and urban local bodies.**
 
• **It is to ** To provide training on effective governance, policymaking, and understanding legal and constitutional frameworks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Commission for Women:

 
 
• It is also one of the significant statutory bodies established by the Government of India.
 
• It was established in 1992 under the provisions of the National Commission for Women Act, 1990. 
 
• The Central Government took the initiative to establish this Commission by keeping in view the provisions of India’s constitution to strengthen the women in the country through addressing plights, suppressions, and other types of violence they use to face.
 
• National Commission for Women also takes the initiatives for the overall development of the women community in the whole country.
